name: Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project
scope: 149.348 km, 64 stations across four corridors: Sampige (Corridor 1), Mallige (Corridor 2), Parijaata (Corridor 3), Kanaka (Corridor 4)
pending: As of a 2025-06-30 status update (The Metro Rail Guy): 0 km operational, 54.9 km under construction, 94.4 km approved but not yet started, out of 149.348 km total. Originally targeted for completion in 2026; more recent reporting suggests this deadline has slipped, but this site has not yet located a primary source confirming a specific revised date, so no current_deadline is recorded.
notes: First K-RIDE record on this site. Corporation set to Central as a placeholder — the four corridors radiate outward across the city; not yet mapped to wards. sanction_date is month-level precision only ("October 2020"), exact day not confirmed. Foundation stone was laid 2023-06-20 by the Prime Minister — noted here rather than as a formal event, since "foundation stone laid" does not fit any type in this site's event schema. The project was first conceived in 1983 and reworked over decades; that pre-2020 history is not yet documented here with dated, sourced figures.
